title: V-JEPA Policy: Building Effective World-Action Models on Predictive Visual Latents
abstract: arXiv:2609.37250v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: World-action models (WAMs) couple future visual-state prediction with action generation. By adapting video generators or image-editing models pretrained at scale, a prominent line of recent WAMs inherits both predictive knowledge and the models in which it was learned. We ask whether a predictive visual latent space induced by large-scale predictive pretraining can instead provide a sufficient foundation for effective WAM learning without inheriting a complete pretrained visual generative model. To answer this question, we introduce V-JEPA Policy, a simple framework that builds a WAM on the latent space of a frozen V-JEPA 2.1 encoder. An instruction-conditioned future-latent predictor and a flow-matching action expert are jointly learned from scratch in a single downstream stage, with the predictor's future-informed context key--value states conditioning action generation. translated_title: V-JEPA Policy：基于预测性视觉潜在表征构建有效的世界-动作模型
translated_abstract: 世界-动作模型将未来视觉状态预测与动作生成耦合在一起。通过适配大规模预训练的视频生成器或图像编辑模型，近期一系列突出的WAM方法既继承了预测知识，也继承了学习这些知识的完整模型。我们提出一个问题：由大规模预测性预训练诱导出的预测性视觉潜在空间，能否在不继承完整预训练视觉生成模型的前提下，为有效的WAM学习提供充分的基础？为回答这一问题，我们提出了V-JEPA Policy，这是一个简单的框架，它在冻结的V-JEPA 2.1编码器的潜在空间上构建世界-动作模型。一个指令条件化的未来潜在预测器和一个流匹配动作专家在单个下游阶段从零开始联合学习，其中预测器的未来信息上下文键-值状态对动作生成进行条件化。该模型总参数量为0.9B，其中0.6B为可训练参数，V-JEPA……
tldr: V-JEPA Policy证明了大规模预测性预训练得到的视觉潜在空间足以作为世界-动作模型的有效基础——只需在冻结的V-JEPA编码器潜在空间上，于单个下游阶段从零联合训练指令条件化的未来潜在预测器和流匹配动作专家，以仅0.6B的可训练参数即可实现有效的机器人策略学习，无需继承完整的预训练视觉生成模型。
en_tdlr: V-JEPA Policy demonstrates that a predictive visual latent space induced by large-scale predictive pretraining is a sufficient foundation for effective world-action model learning, jointly training an instruction-conditioned future-latent predictor and a flow-matching action expert from scratch in a single downstream stage on a frozen V-JEPA encoder's latent space, with only 0.6B trainable parameters and without inheriting a complete pretrained visual generative model.
